svg.title: Fluid editor parity
svg.desc: 53 of 108 items done, 36 partial, 19 open, 0 unknown. Harness and oracle: 11 of 12 done. Published grid CSS: 12 of 13 done. Page and site context: 2 of 7 done. Block types: 2 of 14 done. Geometry and snapping: 5 of 8 done. Gestures: 4 of 12 done. Row stretch: 2 of 5 done. Text editing: 3 of 6 done. Overlap and layers: 3 of 5 done. Phone layout: 4 of 8 done. Section settings and Stacks: 0 of 3 done. Editor chrome: 2 of 7 done. History, save and publish: 2 of 5 done. Accessibility and order: 1 of 3 done.
svg.text: Everything that has to match Fluid Engine, one cell per item.
unknown: needs a trace on the oracle before it can be built
